caseName: Faragher v. City of Boca Raton
caseNameFull: Faragher v. City of Boca Raton

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, December 29, 1997. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, January 28, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, February 18, 1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
